column1: # *** TWO PLATES, TEN YEARS APART, AND THE ARCHIVE WAS WRONG ABOUT BOTH OF THEM. ***
# 11 October 2026. This file replaces one written four hours earlier that argued the opposite case
# and was committed. Keeping the wrong version would have been dishonest; deleting the argument
# would have been worse, so the argument is set out here and then shown to fail.
# *** WHAT THE MORNING BELIEVED. *** A civil index gave Angelica Maria Lerena Villademoros a husband
# "Eduardo ZALDUANDO Pou", his parents Juan and Dolores Pou, and children. All of those people were
# already in this register under *** ZALSAMENDI ***, entered 21 September 2026 off the plate of a
# Pocitos baptism of 1903. The session reasoned: a PLATE outranks an INDEX, therefore ZALSAMENDI is
# right and the index is mangling. It published that.
# *** WHAT THE PLATES SAY. *** Read at full resolution the same afternoon:
#   1903, Pocitos, folio 344 - the entry is HEADED "Maria Zalduondo"; the father is
#     "Eduardo ZALDUONDO"; the paternal grandmother is "Dolores Pou de ZALDUONDO".
#   1913, Montevideo, death act 553 - "ha fallecido Eduardo ZALDUANDO ... era hijo de
#     JUAN ZALDUONDO y de DOLORES POU, fallecidos".
# *** ZALSAMENDI IS ON NEITHER PLATE. IT WAS NEVER A READING OF A DOCUMENT; IT WAS A MISREADING. ***
# *** THE ERROR IN THE ARGUMENT, WHICH IS WORTH MORE THAN THE FACT. ***
# "A plate outranks an index" is true. But this session was not holding a plate - it was holding
# *** ANOTHER SESSION'S READING OF A PLATE ***, and it treated the two as the same thing. The index
# was the only party in the room that had actually been right. There was even a tell in plain view
# and it was read backwards: the archive's own note recorded that a MACHINE transcript of this same
# act had produced "DEL SUANDO". *** TWO READERS FAILING ON ONE HAND IS EVIDENCE THE HAND IS HARD ***
# - it was used instead as evidence that machines and indexes are careless.
# A second tell was ignored outright: the index called the child MARIA MARGARITA *** LUISA ***, a
# fourth name the 1903 reading had dropped. The plate has it. The index was right about that too.

column1: *** The 1903 baptism. *** San Juan Bautista, Pocitos, Montevideo, folio 344, 15 August 1903. Film 007713400 image 02828; ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-R346-Z.
column2: Heading: *** "Maria Zalduondo" ***. "El quince de Agosto de Mil Novecientos tres; yo el infrascrito bautice solemnemente a *** MARIA MARGARITA LUISA ***, que nacio el veintiuno de Junio de este ano; hija legitima de *** EDUARDO ZALDUONDO *** y *** AMELIA LERENA ***, orientales. Abuelos paternos: *** JUAN *** y *** DOLORES POU DE ZALDUONDO ***. Abuelos maternos: *** AVELINO *** y *** CELIDONIA B. DE LERENA ***. Fueron padrinos *** ADOLFO LERENA *** y *** MARIA ANGELICA YUBIA ***."
column3: Kills ZALSAMENDI. Gives the child her fourth name, *** LUISA ***. And its maternal grandparents - *** AVELINO and CELIDONIA B. de LERENA *** - are *** AVELINO EDUARDO LERENA TRAIBEL and CELEDONIA VILLADEMOROS ***, which is what joins this household to the Lerena Villademoros and so to the Lerena Traibel.

column1: *** The 1913 death act. *** Montevideo, certificate 553, 22 August 1913. DGS 008165206 image 283; ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2C-2DNF.
column2: Ha fallecido *** EDUARDO ZALDUANDO ***, del sexo masculino, de nacionalidad oriental, *** NACIDO EN MONTEVIDEO ***, de *** cincuenta y dos anos *** de edad, de estado casado y de profesion *** JUBILADO ***, a consecuencia de *** ANGINA DE PECHO ***, segun consta del certificado del Dr. *** BORDONI POSSE ***. Que el finado era hijo de *** JUAN ZALDUONDO *** y de *** DOLORES POU, FALLECIDOS ***. At seven in the morning, at *** calle JUAN B. BLANCO 9 ***. Declared by *** AGUSTIN AGNESE ***, 28, and *** CONRADO P. ABAL ***, 22, before the Juez de Paz *** EDUARDO J. MORATORIO ***.
column3: Confirms the surname and both parents from a second hand ten years later, and *** ADDS A BIRTHPLACE (MONTEVIDEO), A CAUSE OF DEATH, AN ADDRESS AND A PENSION ***. "Jubilado" at fifty-two means a salaried career this archive has not looked for. *** AND IT KILLS THE IDEA THAT HIS PARENTS COULD STILL BE TRACED ALIVE *** - both were dead by 1913.

column1: *** The sentence that settles the wife. *** Same act, the closing clause.
column2: Asi mismo se hace constar que era casado con *** ANGELICA LERENA ***, de cuya union quedan *** TRES HIJOS *** llamados: *** MARIA ELENA, EDUARDO AVELINO y MARIA MARGARITA ***.
column3: *** ONE CHILD CANNOT BE INSIDE TWO DIFFERENT UNIONS. *** The 1903 act makes Maria Margarita the daughter of AMELIA; this act makes her one of three children of the union with ANGELICA. So *** AMELIA AND ANGELICA ARE ONE WOMAN *** and the sisters-theory is refused by the record itself. *** AND THERE ARE THREE CHILDREN, NOT TWO: MARIA ELENA IS NEW. ***

column1: *** The forename, which is NOT explained - only outvoted. *** Three documents, two names.
column2: Her baptism of 1872 says *** ANGELICA MARIA ***. The 1913 death act says *** ANGELICA ***. Only the 1903 priest wrote *** AMELIA ***, and he wrote it clearly - it was checked at high magnification precisely because it was inconvenient.
column3: *** TWO TO ONE IS NOT AN EXPLANATION. *** This archive does not know why a priest wrote Amelia, and says so. The name is kept as a recorded variant on her row rather than erased, because a reader meeting "Amelia Lerena" in the Pocitos register must be able to find her here.

column1: # *** WHAT WAS MERGED AND WHAT WAS NOT. ***
# MERGED: "Amelia LERENA" into ANGELICA MARIA LERENA VILLADEMOROS, on the shared daughter.
# RENAMED: five rows from ZALSAMENDI to ZALDUONDO; the child gains LUISA.
# ADDED: MARIA ELENA ZALDUONDO Lerena, a name and nothing else.
# STILL MISSING, AND THE REASON ROW 186 DOES NOT CLOSE: *** HER MARRIAGE ACT. *** Everything here
# comes from a baptism and a death. The act that joined Angelica Lerena to Eduardo Zalduondo - which
# would give her age, her residence and her father's own details at the date - has not been found.
